scenes.title: Ode to Joy
scenes.subtitle: Your first melody, by Beethoven.
lines: In this lesson, you'll play the opening melody of Beethoven's Ode to Joy — a simple, uplifting tune that's perfect for your first steps on the guitar.

scenes.heading: Ode to Joy
lines: You'll play Ode to Joy, a joyful melody by Beethoven.
It uses the notes C, D, E, F and G you've learned.
Play slowly and evenly — the app waits for each correct note before moving on.

scenes.title: Ode to Joy
lines: Let's play the opening of Beethoven's Ode to Joy.
Follow the highlighted notes on the tab and fretboard.
Each repeated note needs a fresh pluck.
Play it with confidence — the app is listening, ready to help you sound your best.
